At work

I manage a City Transit division, and I build custom software for it when nothing off the shelf fits. This section collects those tools and what I learn building them.

Projects

Scheduling

Driver scheduling system

A scheduling system for bus operators, with a dispatch board that runs in the browser.

Write-up coming
Paratransit

Paratransit scheduling app

A trip scheduling app for paratransit service, built with Node.js, Express and SQLite.

Write-up coming
Open data

Live vehicle positions feed

A real-time feed of bus locations in GTFS Realtime, the standard format that trip-planning apps read.

Write-up coming
HardwareIn progress

Real-time bus stop display

A prototype arrival display for bus stops, running on a CrowPanel ESP32-S3 board.

Write-up coming
Procurement

Procurement determination tool

A step-by-step wizard that asks about a purchase and produces the price-reasonableness and small-purchase forms.

Write-up coming
Community

Bus coloring and story app

A coloring and story app made for riders as community outreach.

Write-up coming
GameIn progress

LC Transit Simulator

A 3D bus-driving game that runs in the browser, set on the real routes.

Write-up coming

These are short descriptions for now. Full write-ups will cover the problem, the tool and what changed.
